text: {"lessons":["My account fell from 97,192 to 90,048 despite making no trades, so holding still carries market risk; I should review whether my overall allocation suits my ten-year goal.","A short run of losses and a small rebound do not reveal what comes next or which stock drove the change, so I should not chase or sell based only on recent performance.","Before acting, I should use my actual cash, share holdings and current prices to make affordable trades consistent with a deliberate plan."]}
